info.title: Choovie Reporting API
info.description: This API is developed to fulfill Choose Entertainment PTY Ltd. Reporting requirements.

id.description: Unique Booking internal ID from the provider

session.description: Confirmed or proposed session timestamp, in epoch milliseconds (UTC)

session_date.description: Confirmed or proposed session date (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC)

session_time.description: Confirmed or proposed session time (HH:MM, UTC)

period.description: Combination of season and year (e.g. winter_2025). Current-system rows use ongoing_<year>.

product.description: Candy bar product for the booking (e.g. "Pop + Water")

total_carers.description: Carer count. Only counted when the provider includes staff candy bar; otherwise 0.

extra_fee_per_seat.description: Extra fee per seat resolved from the provider's extra-fee rules. Only present on current-system rows (ongoing: true).

total_extra_fees_est.description: extra_fee_per_seat × participants. Only present on current-system rows (ongoing: true).

ongoing.description: Present and true on rows sourced from the current bookings system (not yet archived). Absent on archived rows.

id.description: Unique Booking internal ID from the provider

session.description: Confirmed or proposed session date and time, formatted DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM. Matches what the Choovie app displays — do not apply a timezone conversion.

session_date.description: Confirmed or proposed session date, formatted DD/MM/YYYY

session_time.description: Confirmed or proposed session time, formatted HH:MM

period.description: Combination of season and year (e.g. winter_2025)

product.description: Candy bar product for the booking (e.g. "Pop + Water")

total_carers.description: Carer count. Only counted when the provider includes staff candy bar; otherwise 0.

total_rev_excl_gst_est.description: Estimated revenue excluding GST (per-seat provider fee + extra fees, plus the provider's supplementary invoice rate for the period)

total_rev_incl_gst_est.description: Estimated revenue including GST (per-seat provider fee + extra fees, plus the provider's supplementary invoice rate for the period)

get.description:
Returns all bookings from the system: archived seasons plus current-system bookings, merged and sorted by session ascending.

- **Date filters** (`from` / `to`) must be provided together or not at all, in strict `DD/MM/YYYY` format.
- **`season` / `year`** only filter archived rows; current-system rows (marked `"ongoing": true`, with `period` = `ongoing_<year>`) are always included.
- Pagination: `curr_page` (1-based) takes precedence over `offset` when both are provided.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to return (default 100)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The number of results to skip for pagination

parameters.name: curr_page
parameters.description: The 1-based page number to return. Takes precedence over offset when both are provided.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start date (inclusive), strict DD/MM/YYYY (e.g. 01/09/2025). Must be provided together with `to`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End date (inclusive), strict DD/MM/YYYY (e.g. 30/09/2025). Must be provided together with `from`.

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: Season of the year. Only filters archived rows; current-system rows are always included.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Year to query. Only filters archived rows; current-system rows are always included.

400.description: Invalid input (e.g. bad date format, or only one of from/to provided)

get.description:
Returns archived (historical) bookings only, as a revenue/cost report: each row includes estimated revenue (excl/incl GST, including the provider's supplementary invoice rate for the period) and estimated cost, with provider, service, cinema, and session details.

- **Date filters** (`from` / `to`) must be provided together or not at all, in strict `DD/MM/YYYY` format.
- **`provider_name`** filters by partial match against the OSHC provider display name.
- Session fields are returned as `DD/MM/YYYY` strings, not epoch timestamps — they match what the Choovie app displays, so do not apply a timezone conversion.
- Only archived bookings are returned; current-system bookings never appear here, so every row belongs to a closed period.
- Rows are sorted by session ascending.
- Pagination: `curr_page` (1-based) takes precedence over `offset` when both are provided.

parameters.name: provider_name
parameters.description: Filter by OSHC provider display name (partial match)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to return (default 100)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The number of results to skip for pagination

parameters.name: curr_page
parameters.description: The 1-based page number to return. Takes precedence over offset when both are provided.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start date (inclusive), strict DD/MM/YYYY (e.g. 01/09/2025). Must be provided together with `to`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End date (inclusive), strict DD/MM/YYYY (e.g. 30/09/2025). Must be provided together with `from`.

400.description: Invalid input (e.g. bad date format, or only one of from/to provided)

post.description: Generates an authentication token. The token is valid for 24 hours (86400 seconds).
